name: image_generation
description: Generate an image with Cloudflare Workers AI FLUX only when the user explicitly asks for an image.

generate_image.description: Generate one image from a text prompt with Cloudflare Workers AI. Use only when the user explicitly asks to create or draw an image; never call this proactively. If the requested subject is 墨雪/墨染雪/Nyxie or the assistant herself, set use_moxue_appearance=true so the canonical character design is enforced.

prompt.description: A self-contained image description, maximum 2048 characters. Preserve the user's requested subject, composition, style, text, and constraints.

use_moxue_appearance.description: Set true when the image depicts 墨雪、墨染雪、Nyxie or the assistant herself. The tool will append the canonical appearance, including exactly two nekomata tails.
